name: Goodwe_ESA
description:
The GoodWe ESA Series is a fully integrated all-in-one solar
and storage solution that combines inverter and battery in a
pre-wired, modular design-making installation significantly
faster and easier. Engineered for flexibility, the ESA system
allows seamless expansion to meet evolving energy needs.
5kWh and 8kWh battery modules support 1C charging/
discharging and can be mixed in a single stack up to
48kWh, with up to 6x stacks in parallel. The ESA provides
UPS-level, full house back-up (63A) with no gateway
needed. Models feature 2-4 MPPTs, each supporting up to
26A short-circuit input current. Safety features include 6-level
battery protection and AI-driven AFCI 3.0 as standard, plus
low noise levels of <35dB makes the ESA suitable for a wide
variety of applications.

name: Goodwe_Lynx
description:
The GoodWe Lynx Home F 3.2 kWh Battery Module is a high-voltage lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO₄) energy storage unit designed for use within the Lynx Home F HV battery system. Built for residential solar applications, it delivers reliable performance, high safety standards, and long-lasting durability.

This module features a stackable and modular design, allowing multiple units to be combined to create larger battery systems tailored to different energy requirements. Its plug-and-play architecture with automatic module detection ensures quick and simple installation, reducing setup time for installers.

name: Hiconics

Their batteries are known for stackable, space-saving designs, supporting up to 18 kWh or higher capacities with 6,000+ to 10,000 charge

name: Aether Smart Heat Pump
description:
The Aether Smart Heat Pump range is designed to provide energy-efficient and reliable hot water for Australian households. Using advanced heat pump technology, the system extracts heat from the surrounding air to efficiently heat water while consuming significantly less electricity than conventional electric storage systems.

The Aether Smart series is ideal for homeowners looking to reduce energy bills, improve sustainability, and upgrade to a modern hot water solution. With smart controls, quiet operation, and compatibility with solar systems, the HP200 and HP270 models offer dependable year-round performance for small to large households.

name: Aquatech Dynamic X8
description: The Aquatech Dynamic X8 268L Heat Pump is an advanced energy-efficient hot water system designed for medium to large households. It uses heat pump technology with eco-friendly R290 refrigerant to deliver reliable hot water while significantly reducing electricity consumption compared to traditional electric storage systems. The unit features smart WiFi control, multiple heating modes, solar PV compatibility, low-noise operation, and a durable vitreous enamel tank, making it ideal for Australian residential installations focused on energy savings and sustainability.

name: Aquatech Rapid X6
description: The Aquatech Rapid X6 Heat Pump is an energy-efficient all-in-one hot water system engineered for Australian homes. Featuring advanced hybrid heat pump technology, the Rapid X6 uses environmentally friendly R290 refrigerant to deliver reliable hot water while significantly reducing electricity consumption compared to conventional electric storage systems. Its compact footprint allows simple replacement of standard electric tanks, while smart WiFi controls and solar integration help maximise energy savings.

The unit features intelligent operating modes including Eco, Hybrid, Vacation, and Electric Boost modes for flexible performance and faster hot water recovery when required.
